description: This Java class 'ProductSearchEvents' handles various product search related operations such as adding/removing products or features to/from categories, expiring products, exporting search results, and managing search constraints within the OFBiz framework. It interacts with HTTP requests/responses, database entities, and transaction management.

classes.name: ProductSearchEvents
classes.description: Handles product search operations such as adding/removing products or features, expiring products, exporting search results, and managing search constraints within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: searchRemoveFromCategory
methods.description: Removes search results from a specified category based on current search constraints.

methods.name: searchExpireFromCategory
methods.description: Sets the 'thruDate' for search results in a category to expire them at a specified date.

methods.name: searchAddToCategory
methods.description: Adds search result products to a specified category with a given 'fromDate'.

methods.name: searchAddFeature
methods.description: Adds a feature to all search result products with specified feature details.

methods.name: searchRemoveFeature
methods.description: Removes a specific feature from all search result products.

methods.name: searchExportProductList
methods.description: Exports current search results as a list with product details, categories, and features.

methods.name: getProductSearchResults
methods.description: Retrieves an iterator over search results based on current session constraints.
